[message_id=682058 author=Saurabh Dasgupta first=True]
Hi
I hope you are well. This may have already been answered but I wanted to check.
In order to do this challenge, the competitors will be using Kaggle compute and machines, which will have the "G4 VMs powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs as the compute backbone for this challenge". Hence, I do not have to worry about getting GPU compute from the cloud (unless additional work is needed).
Please let me know.
Many thanks in advance
Saurabh

[message_id=3426251 author=Ashish Kumar Jha first=False]
Yes - You don't have to worry about getting the compute and pay anywhere.
Copy: https://www.kaggle.com/code/ryanholbrook/nvidia-nemotron-submission-demo , then if you want to manually select / change accelerator go to settings -> Accelerator -> GPU RTX Pro 6000

[message_id=3426776 author=Saurabh Dasgupta first=False]
Thank you Ashish. If there are any issues, I will definitely let you know.
Thank you again.
